ma.showModal(Object object)

Display a modal dialog box.

The pop-up window style follows the default pop-up window style of the system, and the style may vary according to different system versions.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
title String No Title of the prompt.
content String No Prompt content.
showCancel Boolean true No Whether to display the cancel button.
cancelText String Cancel No Text on the cancel button. The value contains up to four characters.
cancelColor String #000000 No Text color of the cancel button,the value must be a hexadecimal color string.
confirmText String Confirm No Text on the confirm button. The value contains up to four characters.
confirmColor String #576B95 No Text color of the confirm button,the value must be a hexadecimal color string.
editable Boolean false No Whether to display the text box.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String showModal:ok
content String Text entered by a user when editable is set to true.
confirm Boolean If the value is true, the user clicks the confirm button.
cancel Boolean If the value is true, the user clicks the cancel button.

Sample Code

    ma.showModal({
      title: 'prompt',
      content: 'This is a modal dialog box.',
      success (res) {
        if (res.confirm) {
          console.log('The user clicks the confirm button.')
        } else if (res.cancel) {
          console.log('The user clicks the cancel button.')
        }
      }
    })
